description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: Extend web_widget package router and add its file API module/controller, plus ZAQ host integration callback/event wiring. Mount under the existing widget session pipeline and authenticate using the existing Runtime/session lifecycle on each request. WebWidget.Integration.Session is process-owned: do not deserialize it or reuse a LiveView-owned session in the HTTP process. Resolve the verified sender through ZAQ identity/actor authorization, then call the shared retrieval API. Preserve connector/page binding, expiry, revocation and runtime invalidation. URL possession alone grants nothing; browser parameters cannot supply actor, provider credentials, paths or permission bypass. Package publication/pinning is an explicit release prerequisite, not silently claimed complete.

Tests to add before implementation: HTTP/session integration for authenticated downloads, absent/expired/revoked session, wrong widget/page, runtime replacement, forged URL and cross-message access. Verify safe disposition, MIME, private/no-store caching and no capability leakage.

Branches/paths validated: Host-mounted and package-endpoint modes; reconnect and session refresh; authorized disk/Drive downloads; all rejection paths without source I/O.

Mocking plan: External authentication/provider edges only where required; keep real package session and ZAQ routing/ACL paths.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: Widget package API/session documentation and ZAQ docs/services/web-bridge.md; deployment and version compatibility.

Action reuse assessment: Reuse WebWidget.Router, Embedding.Session, Runtime.authenticate/session validation and ZAQ WebBridge identity paths. Extend the host integration contract for authorized file retrieval. Local-only HTTP adapter; new agent Action would be inappropriate. Depends on the shared retrieval API; do not duplicate Drive/disk downloads or create a bearer-link auth scheme.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.
title: [zaq-pi3.13] Add the widget session-authorized file API
